Recognized as a gifted magician and his sisters' son-in-law, Resto spends his days training for the entrance exam to the Royal Academy as a live-in student... description.en: Ryoichi Aikawa is a high schooler who prefers spending his youth fishing in solitude rather than chasing romance. For him, the tranquility of the harbor is everything—until one day he saves a girl from being harassed by some troublemakers. To his surprise, that girl is Watanabe-san, the incredibly popular school "Madonna". Ever since that unexpected encounter, the school idol has somehow taken an interest in Ryoichi's fishing hobby and started asking about his weekend plans every single week.
description.id: Ryoichi Aikawa adalah seorang siswa SMA yang lebih memilih menghabiskan masa mudanya untuk memancing sendirian daripada mengejar asmara. Baginya, ketenangan di pelabuhan adalah segalanya—sampai suatu hari ia menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang digoda oleh pemancing nakal. Siapa sangka, gadis itu adalah Watanabe-san, sang "Madonna" sekolah yang sangat populer. Sejak pertemuan tak terduga itu, sang idola sekolah entah kenapa mulai tertarik dengan hobi memancing Ryoichi dan selalu menanyakan jadwal akhir pekannya.
description.ja:

「好きです！」
――渡辺さんも釣り好きなの？
「キス…したいです」
――鱚（キス）の天ぷら、作ろうか！

週末にこっそり会う二人は、超スローペースながら少しずつ距離を縮めていき......？
description.pt-br:
Ryoichi Aikawa é um estudante comum do ensino médio apaixonado por pescaria. Um dia, ele ajuda a musa da escola, Misa Watanabe, que estava sendo incomodada por uns caras tentando xavecá-la na praia.

Depois disso, por alguma razão, Watanabe passa a perguntar sobre os planos dele toda semana e acaba sempre arrumando um jeito de sair com ele. Com encontros secretos todos os finais de semana, os dois começam a se aproximar... mas em um ritmo incrivelmente devagar?!

Uma comédia romântica à beira-mar tão fofa que chega a ser frustrante, estrelando uma colegial determinada que parte com tudo para o ataque, e um garoto incrivelmente lerdo, impenetrável como uma muralha de ferro!

description.en:
“I just love you sooooooo much, Senpai!”
My name is Tomoki Yuuki, a second-year student in high school. I'd say I'm a fairly normal student, save for the fact that everyone avoids me like the plague because I apparently look like I'm out for blood. Ike Haruma is the only one that doesn't steer clear of me. He's your typical ‘perfect guy’ in every sense; the protagonist with no real flaws that you see in any given story. 

Life at school was going on as usual… until one day Haruma's super popular little sister confesses to me out of the blue?! Though she later clarifies that her feelings toward me are anything but romantic and that she has an ulterior motive, I end up accepting my new role as ‘fake boyfriend’ as a favor to Haruma. 

Believe it or not, the moment I start going out with her, Haruma's idol-tier childhood friend and my super hot teacher get involved with me too! 

Wait a minute, this can't be a dream rom-com scenario setting itself up for me, can it?! I mean, there's no way a side character like me could be popular, right?

description.en:
The story follows the High-schooler Futsu Jintarou, whose confession was rejected by his crush.

His misfortune continues, as news of a gender-change disease turns Jintarou into a beautiful silver haired girl. The shock of it causes him (her) to try to escape from reality by playing the VRMMO, Clan/Clan…

His game character Taro uses the same girl appearance as in the Real and the Alchemy skill, which most players call a trash skill.  
He meets lots of fellow adventurers, and becomes stronger within the game world of Clan/Clan’s slogan, ‘When one becomes an adventurer, they can fight, steal, control, explore, invent, create, and do anything as they like’.

He meets a wide variety of adventurers that help him (her) grow, Taro hides what happened to his (her) appearance as a bug to his friends who also play the game, and hides the fact that he (she) had become a girl in real life.

When summer break is over, he(she) will have to show their face at school.

This is about one of the best National-class adventurers, the story of the Alchemist who won a war without even taking a single step.  
When a normal high school student suddenly turns into a beautiful girl, what would they do?

The answer is to that is to become an online games' addict!
description.ru: История рассказывает нам о Фуцу Дзинтаро, обычном, среднестатистическом, японском школьнике,  у которого произошло самопроизвольное опорожнение кишечника во время попытки признаться. Но это только начало, так как наш юноша внезапно становится… Беловолосой маленькой девочкой! Шок от этого заставляет его погрузиться в мир VRMMO – Clan/Clan. Его персонаж, Таро, выглядит так же, как и сам Дзинтаро, в нынешнем обличии. Еще он владеет Алхимией, которую все называют худшим скиллом в игре. Он встречает множество искателей приключений и прокачивается дальше. Как говорится в слогане Clan/Clan – “Когда ты становишься искателем приключений – ты можешь сражаться, воровать, исследовать, создавать и делать всё, что тебе захочется!”.  Люди, с которыми он повстречался, помогли ему прокачаться. Таро скрывает, что с ним случилось в реальной жизни, объясняя смену аватара в игре, багом и никому не говорит о том, что он стал девочкой. Но, когда летние каникулы закончатся, ему (ей) предстоит выйти в реальный мир… Что делать обычному школьнику, если он стал девочкой? Правильно! Стать задротом!

Saya bereinkarnasi sebagai putri jahat dalam game otome berdasarkan dunia modern.

Tetapi karena ini adalah dunia modern, kehidupan lambat seorang penjahat memiliki banyak kesulitan, dan sejarah Jepang modern, sejarah ekonomi modern, dan ekonomi global menyerang karakter utama saat dia mencoba mengatur urusan rumah tangga.

Bertahanlah, penjahat! Jangan kalah, penjahat!

Ini adalah kisah tentang perjuangan Keikain Runa, seorang putri jahat yang melemparkan dirinya ke dalam pemalsuan sejarah dan perang uang, meninggalkan karakter utama dan target penangkapan untuk menjalani kehidupan yang lambat, dengan latar belakang Perang Dunia yang hilang , runtuhnya gelembung ekonomi, dan krisis keuangan yang mengancam.

description.ru:
Женщина перевоплощается в злодейку в ретро-отомэ-игре... где ей предстоит пережить надвигающуюся Великую Рецессию 2008 года!

Когда в сентябре 2008 года экономика рушится, судьба измученной карьеристки остаётся в подвешенном состоянии... пока она не перевоплощается! Теперь она Кэйкайн Руна - дочь семьи Кэйкайн, владеющей Кэйка Групп - в отомэ-игре, действие которой разворачивается после схлопывания японского экономического пузыря. Финансовое положение Кэйка Групп оставляет желать лучшего: если не принять меры, они окажутся на грани разорения. Однако Руна намерена спасти и холдинг, и Японию с помощью рискованных и умных инвестиций. Благодаря интересу к холодным деньгам, знанию технологий будущего и осознанию того, что Япония в реальном мире обречена на гибель, Руна, возможно, сумеет предотвратить надвигающийся экономический крах. Станьте свидетелем возрождения экономики Японии, когда Руна использует свои знания, чтобы спасти свое новое настоящее от будущего!

Yukino Suzushiro es una estudiante de primer año que pertenece a la división Shakuyaku de niñas 'pobres' en la Escuela Secundaria Femenina Douwa, basada en clases sociales y la segregación clasista. description.en:
After Koganei was rejected by a girl he had confessed to, he angrily ran off and was hit by a car.   
  
When he woke up, he found that he was reincarnated in another world as Theodore Goldberg, the eldest son of a marquis. And of course, as Koganei is no stranger to isekai series, he knows that he will have some sort of cheat skill to become overpowered and live a slow life.   
  
And so he tries to open up his status screen… only to find that this world doesn’t have video game stats. He then tries to use his OP magic skills… only to find out he is too young to even learn magic. So then he tries swordsmanship… but turns out to be weak with the blade. And so he decides to just invent modern technology to get ahead… only to find out that this world has magical devices which are identical to modern technology.   
  
Theodore is at an impasse. He’s not strong, he’s not smart, and he’s not handsome. So what exactly is his cheat skill? For what purpose was he reincarnated in the first place if he was just reborn as an ordinary boy?


[Webnovel raw](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0391dt/)
description.ms:
Pasca pengakuan cintanya kepada seorang gadis mendapat penolakan, Koganei dengan murkanya lari pergi dan kemudian ia tertabrak oleh mobil.

Tatkala ia bangun, ia mendapati bahwasanya dirinya telah tereinkarnasi menuju dunia lain sebagai Theodore Goldberg, seorang putra sulung dari Keluarga Marquis. Dan tentunya, sebagaimana Koganei tidaklah asing akan seri budaya isekai, ia tahu bahwa ia kan memdapati dirinya dianugerahi semacam kuasa curang tuk menjadi adikuasa nan digdaya dan kan menjalani kehidupan yang tenteram.

Dengan begitu, ia pun mencoba membuka layar status… hanya tuk mendapati bahwasanya dunia ini tiasalah memiliki elemen status video game, Lalu ia mencoba mendayakan sihir adikuasanya… hanya tuk mendapati kenyataan bahwa ia masih terlalu belia untuk mampu mempelajari sihir. Tak patah arang, ia pun mencoba seni berpedang… namun ternyata ia begitu lemah dengan pedang. Kemudian ia pun memutuskan tuk mencipta teknologi modern tuk memajukan… hanya tuk menjumpa bahwasanya dunia ini memiliki peralatan magis yang serupa terhadap teknologi modern.

Theodore pun menghadapi kebuntuan. Ia tidaklah tangguh, tidaklah cerdas, pula tidaklah rupawan. Jadi apahal sebenarnya kuasa curang miliknya? Dan pula serta utama apahal tujuan ia tereinkarnasi jikalau ia hanya 'kan terlahir kembali sebagai seorang bocah laki-laki yang biasa saja?

description.en:
"Hey! I'm an evil god, but I'm not actually evil!"

Those were the first words I heard in the afterlife. My name's Naofumi Kamiya, and my entire class died in a tragic bus accident. The god told my classmates that he would transport all of us to a dangerous new world, but he created skills for us on request, so maybe he was actually a good god? That's what I thought at first, anyway. But when it sounds too good to be true, it probably is! 

I feel bad for my classmates who thought that gimmicky skills would make them invincible. I mean, the god did warn them that there were no cheat skills! Oh well. As for myself, I'm enjoying my life with my childhood friends, putting safety first and staying out of trouble. After all, this world might seem like a game, but it’s not. It's reality.

Sozai Shuu, a working adult with a slightly weird habit of loving to collect raw materials, was transferred to another world by God after losing his life.

In order to live leisurely, Shuu wished for 『a power to live a carefree life collecting raw materials in another world.』His wish was successfully granted however, his magic power is strangely enormous, and his skill is really convenient? Seems like God misunderstood that he wanted to harvest materials from monsters leisurely so the power he gave Shuu was so incredible….

Nevertheless, Shuu does not take it to mind and freely uses his unique skill 【Detect】 in another world to search for materials, harvest them, eat them, make money off of them and lives a carefree life collecting materials.

description.en:
"Forget what you saw today."  
  
There's something odd about Sakuta Azusagawa, an acerbic, standoffish high schooler who doesn't even own a cell phone in this day and age. And perhaps strange things happen to strange people, which is why on the last day of the Golden Week holiday, in a tranquil library, he meets a wild bunny girl. With that unforgettable encounter, their bizarre and mysterious love story begins.  


---
description.ru:
"Эй, может поцелуемся?"  
  
Она та, которая дразнила меня этими соблазнительными словами, на время исчезла перед моими глазами. Больше нет девочки-зайки, обитающей в библиотеке.  
  
Ацусагава Сакута увидел сцену, которая свергла его здравый смысл - он встретил зайку, и она совершенно не обычная девочка-зайка. Она - Сакураджима Маи, учиться в той же школе, что Сакута, и известная актриса в отставке.  
Несколько дней назад, было сказано, что люди из её окружения не могли больше видеть её, и она пришла в библиотеку, чтобы подтвердить это.  
Связано ли это с попаданием темы в интернете, невообразимого явления, известного как "пубертатный синдром"?Сакута, желая знать причины решил приблизиться к Маи и решить головоломку.  
Однако ситуация стала развиваться неожиданным образом.  
  
В городе, окруженный небесами и морями, романтическая история обычного меня и её - началась!
description.tr:
"Hey, öpüşelim mi?"

Kütüphanede oturan bir tavşan kız olması imkansızdı. Azusagawa Sakuta, sağduyuyu altüst eden bir sahneyle karşılaştı- bir tavşan kız karşısında duruyordu ve o normal bir kız değildi. Sakurajima Mai, Sakuta ile aynı okulda okuyan bir öğrenci ve emekli olmuş ünlü bir aktirs. Birkaç gün öncesinden itiaren etrafındakilerin artık onu göremediğini ve bunu doğrulamak için kütüphanete geldiğini söyledi. Bu, internetteki hayalgücünü zorlayan popüler olgu "ergenlik sendromu" ile mi ilgili? Bunun arkasındaki nedenleri bilmek ve Mai'ye yaklaşmak isteyen Sakuta, bulmacayı çözmeye karar verdi. Ancak, durum daha sonra beklenmedik bir şekilde gelişti ve—?

description.en: 29-year-old freeter Ikuta Hiroto is a carefree young man without a love life, regular job, or any real worries about the future. He inherits an old house from the neighbourhood granny, where his 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi moves in with him to study art in Tokyo. This is a story about Hiroto and the people around him who struggle with life.

В наследство от соседской бабушки ему достаётся старый дом, куда переезжает его восемнадцатилетняя двоюродная сестра Нацуми, чтобы учиться искусству в Токио. Це історія про Хірото та людей навколо нього, які борються з життям.
description.pt-br: Ikuta Hiroto, de 29 anos, é um jovem despreocupado sem uma vida amorosa, emprego regular ou qualquer preocupação real com o futuro: um "freeter". biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 真造圭伍

Shinzou Keigo is an alumni of the Fine Arts school in Tokyo Zokei University. 

His major work includes *Bokura no Funkasai*, which won a New Face Award in the 16th Japan Media Arts Festival. He is also known for *Moriyamachuu Kyoushuujo* and *Midori no Hoshi*, both published by Shougakukan. *Moriyamachuu Kyoushuujo* was made into a movie in July 2016 and *Tokyo Alien Bros* adapted to Japanese drama in 2018. 

He was hospitalized for malignant lymphoma during the coronavirus pandemic which inspired him to make a manga essaying chronicles of his treatment and recovery and how he came up with the idea for his new series, *Hirayasumi*. 

He's married to [Taniguchi Natsuko](https://mangadex.org/author/c6fe4c99-798c-470b-9e6a-0ea94315a902).

To everyone else, Momoyama-sensei is an unmatched beauty, but second-year student Tamotsu Kurita sees something they don’t—that she’s also a massive nerd! Her love of 2D characters—and only 2D characters—knows no bounds, and try as she might, she just can’t hide it. To Kurita, being around a beautiful lady who shares his interests is a dream come true, but Momoyama-sensei’s more excited to talk about her favorite fictional idols than anything else…

description.en:
An immensely powerful and ancient dragon, once worshipped as a god by humans but now only a myth in their eyes, wakes up one day to find a human girl poking around his lair. The infant is barely old enough to say her own name, but is quite confident in calling the dragon “Daddy”!

Bewildered by the unexpected visitor, the dragon soon learns that returning her to human civilization isn’t going to be an option... not yet, anyway. He quickly decides to raise the girl himself, determined to give her a happy life that will lead her back to human society when she is older — surely a simple task for a legendary being such as himself.

All he needs to do now is find a place for her to sleep. And figure out where he is going to get clothes for her. And...wait, what do humans eat again?

---
“Daddy!” The dragon blinked as the wee little human called out to him. Him? Her “Daddy”? Powerful enough to have been venerated by humankind, yet warmhearted and even a tad ditzy, the dragon soon finds himself raising and doting on the precocious Olivia as if she really were his daughter in this touching tale. The toddler may be impossibly cute now, but just you wait—she’s a curious child and she’s growing up real fast. You can bet that one day, she’ll be the strongest human there is! But first, how will he handle little Olivia receiving an acceptance letter to a human school?

---

description.en: With his carthorse as his only companion, the young merchant Kraft Lawrence slowly wends his way through dusty back roads in search of profitable trade. But this monotony screeches to a halt when, one night, he encounters a harvest goddess in the guise of a beautiful young girl…with wolf ears and a tail! Longing for the northern lands of her birth, Holo the Wisewolf joins Lawrence as he follows the ebb and flow of trade through the countryside. And when the two come across a compelling but suspicious opportunity for profit, will Lawrence with his mercantile chops and Holo with her ancient instincts be able to separate the truth from the lies — and make some coin while they’re at it?!
description.ru:
За семь лет утомительных поездок по пыльным дорогам юный торговец Крафт Лоуренс привык к такому образу жизни, когда целью становится поиск сделок, способных принести прибыль. Во время всех путешествий его единственным компаньоном оставалась лошадь. Это однообразие заканчивается, когда в повозке он обнаруживает спящую богиню урожая в обличии молодой красивой девушки с волчьими ушами и хвостом.
Тоска по родным заснеженным лесам Йойса становится причиной, по которой Холо просит Лоуренса доставить её до родины. На их пути окажется немало знакомств, трудностей и авантюр. Но соглашаясь на совместное странствие, торговец не догадывается, что попутчица в знак благодарности будет помогать как в сложных ситуациях, так и в обстоятельствах, которые казались ему идеальными. Ведь недаром волчица при каждой возможности называет себя мудрой и хвастается ушками, отличающими истину ото лжи!

---
